text:
Maya Chen: FYI vendor LumenBridge submitted invoice INV-8912 for 'HW maintenance' but there's no PO linked in Coupa. AP flagged it for hold. Can someone check approver routing? cc @Omar Patel
Omar Patel: I'm pulling it up. Do we have a PO for that vendor? Running a quick search...
Jin Park: Found a PO 555102 that seems to match the line items, but vendor code on the PO is LUMEN-OLD. Looks like vendor used an outdated vendor ID so Coupa didn't auto-link the invoice.
Claudia Rivera: That explains it — when vendor_id != vendor master record the approval workflow goes to Procurement Ops instead of Infra. AP should hold payment until mapping is fixed or we do a one-off approval.
ApprovalsBot: Invoice INV-8912 placed on HOLD: reason=PO_not_linked; action_required=manual_link_or_exception_approval. Suggested reviewer=@Claudia Rivera.
LumenBridge AP: We can reissue with vendor id LUMEN-NEW if that helps, but vendor ops asked if you can accept the current invoice header while we update our records. Terms are Net30.
Maya Chen: AP, please hold payment for now. Omar — how long for procurement to update the vendor mapping? We have a 5 business day SLA for disputed invoices.
Omar Patel: Submitted procurement sync ticket PR-2026-74. Procurement quoted 2-3 business days. In parallel I'll try a manual PO link so it routes to Infra approver.
Jin Park: Tried to link with coupa-cli: `coupa-cli link-invoice --invoice INV-8912 --po 555102` returned error: vendor_id_mismatch. I'll escalate to procurement and attach a note for manual exception.
Claudia Rivera: If manual link can't be done, please route the invoice to me for an exception approval and note the vendor update ticket. We'll mark as 'one-off approve - hold final payment until vendor id reconciled'.
ApprovalsBot: Emergency exception route applied: reviewer=Claudia Rivera; policy=one-off-exception-v1.2. Invoice remains on HOLD until approval action. :warning:
Maya Chen: Thanks — let's keep this tight. AP hold payment, Procurement please prioritize PR-2026-74, and Claudia will approve if linking fails. I'll follow up EOD with status. :thumbsup:
